                    f"[sweep-gates] FAIL: {len(sweep_fails)} issue(s):\n"
                    + "\n".join("  " + f for f in sweep_fails[:10])
                    + (f"\n  … and {len(sweep_fails)-10} more" if len(sweep_fails) > 10 else "")
                )
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[postedit-check] SKIP sweep-gates: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        print("[postedit-check] SKIP sweep-gates: type_check.py absent", file=sys.stderr)

    # (c) QC scripts on reel dir
    for script_rel, label in [
        ("content_check.py",   "content"),
        ("frame_check.py",     "frame"),
        ("lane_check.py",      "lane"),
        ("beat_lint.py",       "beat-lint"),
        ("banned_card_check.py","banned-card"),
    ]:
        script = qc_dir / script_rel
        if not script.exists():
            print(f"[postedit-check] SKIP {label}: {script} absent", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        extra = ["--gate-s", "warn"] if script_rel == "beat_lint.py" else []
        rc, out = run_qc(["python3", str(script), str(reel_dir)] + extra, label)
        if rc == -1:
            print(out, file=sys.stderr)  # SKIP
        elif rc >= 2:
            fails.append(f"[{label}] FAIL (exit {rc}):\n{out[:500]}")

    # bookend_check.py
    bc = scripts_dir / "bookend_check.py"
    if bc.exists():
        rc, out = run_qc(["python3", str(bc), str(reel_dir)], "bookend")
        if rc == -1:
            print(out, file=sys.stderr)
        elif rc >= 2:
            fails.append(f"[bookend] FAIL (exit {rc}):\n{out[:500]}")
    else:
        print("[postedit-check] SKIP bookend: bookend_check.py absent", file=sys.stderr)

    # Append reel dir to touched-reel ledger (dedupe)
    ledger_dir = project_dir / ".claude" / "tmp"
    ledger_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ledger = ledger_dir / f"touched-reels-{session_id}.txt"
    reel_abs = str(reel_dir.resolve())
    existing = set()
    if ledger.exists():
        existing = set(ledger.read_text().splitlines())
    if reel_abs not in existing:
        with ledger.open("a") as lf:
            lf.write(reel_abs + "\n")

# ── scenes.py ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
elif fname.endswith("scenes.py"):
    for script_rel, label in [
        ("static_scene_check.py", "static-scene"),
        ("wcag_margin_check.py",  "wcag-margin"),
    ]:
        script = qc_dir / script_rel
        if not script.exists():
            print(f"[postedit-check] SKIP {label}: {script} absent", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        rc, out = run_qc(["python3", str(script), str(fpath), "--quiet"], label)
        if rc == -1:
            print(out, file=sys.stderr)
        elif rc >= 2:
            fails.append(f"[{label}] FAIL (exit {rc}):\n{out[:500]}")

# ── Remotion *.tsx in scenes/ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
elif (fname.endswith(".tsx")
      and "remotion" in str(fpath).lower()
      and "scenes" in str(fpath).lower()):
    # GATE TIER-0 (blocking): content props must default to sentinel, never plausible copy.
    # Ref: REMOTION-STANDARDS §6. Implementation: runtime/qc/content_default_check.py
    content_check = qc_dir / "content_default_check.py"
    if not content_check.exists():
        print(f"[postedit-check] SKIP content-default: {content_check} absent", file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        rc, out = run_qc(["python3", str(content_check), str(fpath)], "content-default")
        if rc == -1:
            print(out, file=sys.stderr)
        elif rc >= 2:
            fails.append(f"[content-default] FAIL (exit {rc}):\n{out[:500]}")
    # Legacy advisory checks (kept for any remaining output; non-blocking)
    for script_rel, label in [
        ("zdefault_audit.py",        "zdefault"),
        ("audit_default_guards.py",  "default-guards"),
    ]:
        script = (qc_dir if script_rel == "zdefault_audit.py"
                  else scripts_dir) / script_rel
        if not script.exists():
            continue
        rc, out = run_qc(["python3", str(script), str(fpath)], label)
        if out.strip():
            print(f"[{label}] advisory:\n{out[:500]}", file=sys.stderr)
        # Advisory only — always exit 0 for these

# ── FACTCHECK.md ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
elif fname == "FACTCHECK.md":
    reel_dir = fpath.parent
    script = qc_dir / "factcheck_check.py"
    if not script.exists():
        print("[postedit-check] SKIP factcheck: factcheck_check.py absent", file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        rc, out = run_qc(["python3", str(script), str(reel_dir)], "factcheck")
        if rc == -1:
            print(out, file=sys.stderr)
        elif rc >= 2:
            fails.append(f"[factcheck] FAIL (exit {rc}):\n{out[:500]}")

# ── Everything else ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
else:
    sys.exit(0)

if fails:
    print("\n".join(fails), file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
sys.exit(0)
PYEOF

  ffmpeg -y -ss $t -i /Users/bear/Documents/CoWork/bear-textbooks/books/anthropics/claude-code-101/01-context-and-memory/cc-buildlog-assessment/media/$beat.mp4 -frames:v 1 -q:v 3 /tmp/cc-frames/${beat}-late.jpg 2>&1 > /dev/null
done && ls /tmp/cc-frames/ | grep late

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""author_sheet.py — cc-buildlog-assessment (cc-explainer · Claude Code 101 · tier 01, film 04)
"Why Your Students' CLAUDE.md Is the Best Evidence They Conducted the Build."
Every block traces to SESSION.md (three real fresh runs). Liam, in for Bear."""
import json, os
SLUG="cc-buildlog-assessment"
TITLE="Why Your Students' CLAUDE.md Is the Best Evidence They Conducted the Build"
TOPIC="CLAUDE CODE 101"
LIAM="am_onyx"
WPS=2.9
ASK="Add a password-protected login to signup.html so only known members can sign up."
beats=[]

def est(t): return round(len(t.split())/WPS+0.9,1)

def B(bid, act, lane, voice, narration, element, shot, show, **extra):
    b={"beat_id":bid,"act":act,"lane":lane,"narration_text":narration,"estimated_duration_s":est(narration),"voice":voice,"engine":"kokoro",
       "voice_kokoro":voice,"new_visual_element":element,"shot":shot,"show":show}
    b.update(extra); beats.append(b)

def R(pattern, props, motion="type", **shot_extra):
    s={"type":"REMOTION","source":"own","motion":motion,"remotion":{"pattern":pattern,"props":props,"rendered":{"out":"","at":""}}}
    s.update(shot_extra); return s

def writer(text, trig, rep, seed):
    return {"text":text,"triggerWords":trig,"replacementWords":rep,"face":"serif","fontSize":78,"align":"center","ink":"#F2F0E9","accent":"#D97757","bg":"#1F1E1B","seed":seed,
            "charMs":22,"hesitateBetween":6,"hesitateWithin":1,"mistakeRate":5,"jitter":20}

def session(title, mode, blocks, cues, mascot="auto"): return {"title":title,"mode":mode,"blocks":blocks,"cues":cues,"mascot":mascot}


B("B00","COLD OPEN","TERMINAL",LIAM,
  "This is Liam, in for Bear. Two students, same assignment. Both hand in a working sign-up page — same fifty-four lines, diff is silent. And two very different CLAUDE dot m d files: thirty-six lines with dates in it, and four lines of good vibes. The code cannot tell you which student conducted the build. This file can.",
  "CCSession — the setup: two folders, same code, different CLAUDE.md sizes",
  R("CCSession", session("assess — two students","default",[
      {"type":"prompt","text":"!ls student-a student-b","cue":0,"typeDuration":40},
      {"type":"text","text":"student-a: CLAUDE.md  signup.html"},
      {"type":"text","text":"student-b: CLAUDE.md  signup.html"},
      {"type":"prompt","text":"!wc -l student-*/signup.html","cue":0,"typeDuration":44},
      {"type":"text","text":"      54 student-a/signup.html"},
      {"type":"text","text":"      54 student-b/signup.html"},
      {"type":"prompt","text":"!diff -q student-a/signup.html student-b/signup.html","cue":0,"typeDuration":66},
      {"type":"text","text":"(silent — the files are identical)"},
      {"type":"prompt","text":"!wc -l student-*/CLAUDE.md","cue":0,"typeDuration":40},
      {"type":"text","text":"      36 student-a/CLAUDE.md"},
      {"type":"text","text":"       4 student-b/CLAUDE.md"},
  ],[0,45,65,95,150,170,215,285,320,370,395], mascot="off")),
  [{"at":0.05,"event":"ls both folders"},{"at":0.4,"event":"diff silent"},{"at":0.9,"event":"36 vs 4"}])

B("BIDEA","THE IDEA","IDEA",LIAM,
  "Here's the idea of this film. You can grade the code, but any AI can generate any code — so grading the code from the AI era measures the AI, not the student. What you can grade is the CLAUDE dot m d: the file the student writes before Claude touches anything, and the dated entries they add when Claude got confidently wrong. The code came from Claude. The file came from the student. The file is the assessment.",
  "BrutalistHesitantWriter — 'code' reconsidered into 'file'",
  R("BrutalistHesitantWriter", writer(
      "You can grade the code.\nAny AI can generate any code.\nThe CLAUDE.md is what the student wrote.\nThe file is the assessment.",
      "code","file",SLUG), motion="type",
    leaves_terminal_because="the idea of the film is not in any session; the writer types it and corrects the one word the film exists to fix"),
  [{"at":0.05,"event":"Writer starts"},{"at":0.35,"event":"'code' → 'file'"},{"at":0.9,"event":"Last line"}])

B("BDEFS","DEFINITIONS","CARD",LIAM,
  "Five words before we start. CLAUDE dot m d: the file Claude reads at session start — constraints, context, lessons. Lessons Learned: dated entries a student writes when Claude was confidently wrong. Dangerous middle: the step where Claude looked right and only the audit caught it. Conducting: the human's supervisory work — decide, gate, audit, judge. Assessment: the artefact you grade; it should measure the student, not the model.",
  "CCDefinitions — five terms",
  R("CCDefinitions",{"title":"TERMS IN THIS FILM","terms":[
      {"term":"CLAUDE.md","meaning":"the file Claude reads at session start; constraints, context, lessons"},
      {"term":"Lessons Learned","meaning":"dated entries a student writes when Claude was confidently wrong"},
      {"term":"Dangerous middle","meaning":"the step where Claude looked right and only the audit caught it"},
      {"term":"Conducting","meaning":"the human's supervisory work — decide, gate, audit, judge"},
      {"term":"Assessment","meaning":"the artefact you grade; measures the student, not the model"}],
    "startCue":12,"rowGap":48}, motion="drawon", leaves_terminal_because="definitions for a chat-window audience"),
  [{"at":0.05,"event":"First term"},{"at":0.5,"event":"Terms land"},{"at":0.9,"event":"Hold"}])

B("B01","SAME ASK — STUDENT A","TERMINAL",LIAM,
  "Same one-sentence ask to Student A: add a password-protected login. It refused — and it refused on this project's rules, not on principle. It quoted the August fourteen lesson by date, and by name: the email wall, twelve friends who already know each other. It named three alternatives — a private host, a pre-filled roster, a shared passphrase — each labelled with the constraint it respects. That refusal did not come from the model. It came from the file.",
  "CCSession — Student A: refusal quoting 2026-08-14 by date",
  R("CCSession", session("student-a — same ask","accept-edits",[
      {"type":"prompt","text":ASK,"cue":0,"typeDuration":80},
      {"type":"text","text":"I can't add that. CLAUDE.md is explicit:"},
      {"type":"text","text":"No email or password field."},
      {"type":"text","text":"No account. No sign-up wall."},
      {"type":"text","text":"The 2026-08-14 email wall lesson"},
      {"type":"text","text":"is exactly this: twelve friends"},
      {"type":"text","text":"who already know each other."},
      {"type":"text","text":"Three options that fit the rules:"},
      {"type":"text","text":"— private host (no page auth)"},
      {"type":"text","text":"— pre-filled roster (pick a name)"},
      {"type":"text","text":"— shared passphrase (still a wall)"},
  ],[0,95,130,155,180,215,245,275,310,340,375], mascot="off")),
  [{"at":0.05,"event":"Same ask"},{"at":0.4,"event":"'The 2026-08-14 lesson'"},{"at":0.9,"event":"Three alternatives"}])

B("B02","WHY IT KNEW","SHELL",LIAM,
  "How did it know. Student A's CLAUDE dot m d is auto-loaded at session start — Claude read it before typing anything. Three headers, each dated. Each one names the exact wrong move — the dangerous middle — and the constraint the student added because of it. The August fourteen entry is the one Claude just quoted, word for word.",
  "CCPlainShell — grep the dated headers; sed the first entry",
  R("CCPlainShell",{"title":"zsh — scratch/","lines":[
      "$ grep '^### ' student-a/CLAUDE.md",
      "### 2026-08-14 — the email wall",
